eye_input.step: grid step nm (1, or 5 for ablation_grid5)
eye_input.spd_sha256: sha256 of the recipe SPD as little-endian float64 bytes
eye_input.td: retinal illuminance (td) of the at-retina SPD
eye_input.packets: [[wavelength_nm, count], ...] column-agnostic; Arm B assigns the column
eye_input.duplicate_of: id of first entry with identical packets (or null)
eye_input.identical_to: (wrong_observer only, replaces the above) base stimulus id
